goal: Restore the read-only abandonment audit by proving required checks and fresh preview ledger under its scheduled workflow token, with a main-only secret guard
prohibited_actions: Do not read or change database claims or leases
Do not mutate database or infrastructure
assumptions: The workflow exposes the configured preview ref through vars.PREVIEW_PROJECT_REF and the existing repository secret SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN
The preview ledger helper executes a constant SELECT and fails on missing or conflicting project refs
The credential-bearing audit job runs only after a failing non-main ref gate passes on main; branch dispatch fails visibly
stop_conditions: Stop if a non-main workflow dispatch can reach the credential-bearing audit job
Stop if an empty or conflicting preview ref becomes a clean result
Stop if the audit can write a claim, lease, or database row
Stop if protected-source collisions cannot be serialized
